name: HubToolify Icons
author: hubtoolify

sections.description:
HubToolify Icons adds an Icon block to the editor. Search the HubToolify library by name or meaning (try “rocket”, “cart” or “secure”), pick a style, and click an icon to insert it. Set its size, colour, alignment and alternative text in the block settings.

It also adds a Sticker block. Browse 1,400+ HubToolify stickers (festivals such as Diwali, Christmas and Navratri, birthdays, thank-you notes, small-business labels, cute animals and more, still and animated), filter by pack, and click one. The sticker is saved in your Media Library and becomes an ordinary Image block. Stickers are part of HubToolify Pro: everyone can browse them, and inserting needs a connected Pro account.

  • 3,700+ original icons drawn on one 24 px grid, across 44 categories.
  • Free styles: Line, Solid and Duotone, for everyone, no account needed.
  • Pro styles: Sharp Line, Sharp Solid, Sharp Duotone, Imprint, Pixel, Slab, Mellow, Draw, Duo, Flat, Jass, 3D and Lineal. Connect a HubToolify account with an active Pro plan to insert them.
  • Fast pages: each icon is saved in your post as a small inline SVG. Your pages load no icon font, no script and nothing from HubToolify.
  • Yours to keep: inserted icons stay in your posts, and stickers in your Media Library, if you disconnect, your plan ends or you remove the plugin.
  • 1,400+ stickers (Pro): still stickers as 512 px WebP; animated stickers as animated WebP or GIF. Each is saved once in your Media Library and reused after that.
  • Accessible: add alternative text for icons that carry meaning; decorative icons are hidden from screen readers.

Each WordPress user connects their own HubToolify account, from the block or from Settings → HubToolify Icons. Connecting shows a short code that you enter on hubtoolify.com; no password is ever typed into WordPress.

The [hti] shortcode from the earlier version keeps working for the free styles, e.g. [hti name="rocket" style="solid" size="32" color="#1766f2"].

External services

This plugin uses the HubToolify service at https://hubtoolify.com to search the icon and sticker libraries and to fetch the icons and stickers you insert. Without it the plugin cannot find or insert them.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you search in the block: your search words, the chosen style, category and page number. Sent from your site’s server.
  • When you insert an icon (or the [hti] shortcode shows an icon for the first time): the icon’s name and style. For a Pro style, the access token of the HubToolify account you connected is sent too, so HubToolify can check your Pro plan.
  • When you search stickers: your search words, the chosen pack, the still/animated filter and the page number.
  • When you insert a sticker: the sticker’s name, the format (WebP or GIF) and the access token of the HubToolify account you connected, so HubToolify can check your Pro plan. HubToolify counts the download for its “Trending” list and for your own “My library” page.
  • When you connect or disconnect your account: your site’s address (to name the connection on your HubToolify account page), and the temporary code and token used to connect.
  • Every request also carries your site’s address in its User-Agent.

No visitor data is sent: requests are made only from the WordPress admin by logged-in users, or once per icon by the [hti] shortcode, never from your visitors’ browsers. Icon and sticker previews in the editor are loaded from hubtoolify.com.

The service is provided by HubToolify: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New.
  2. In the editor, add the HubToolify Icon block, search, and click an icon.
  3. For stickers, add the HubToolify Sticker block, search, and click a sticker (needs a connected Pro account and a role that can upload files).
  4. For Pro styles and stickers: in the block’s “HubToolify account” panel (or Settings → HubToolify Icons) click Connect HubToolify account, then enter the code shown on hubtoolify.com/connect.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

No. Line, Solid and Duotone icons work without an account. An account with an active HubToolify Pro plan unlocks the 13 Pro styles and the stickers.

What happens to my icons if my Pro plan ends?

Icons and stickers you already inserted stay in your posts and Media Library and keep working. Only inserting new Pro icons and stickers stops until the plan is active again.

Does it slow down my site?

No. Icons are stored in the post as small SVGs. The plugin adds one tiny stylesheet and no JavaScript to your pages, and your pages never contact HubToolify.

Where do stickers go?

Into your Media Library, as an image file named after the sticker, with its name as the alternative text. The block then becomes a normal Image block, so you can resize, align, link or caption it like any image. Inserting the same sticker again in the same format reuses that file.

Why can my Contributors not insert stickers?

A sticker is saved as a file, and WordPress only lets roles with the “upload files” permission (Authors and above) add files. Contributors can still use the Icon block.

Can every editor on my site use my Pro account?

No. Each WordPress user connects their own HubToolify account; a Pro plan covers one person.

How do I disconnect?

In Settings → HubToolify Icons (or the block’s account panel) click Disconnect. You can also remove the connection on hubtoolify.com under Account → Connected apps.

How is the icon licensed?

The plugin’s code is GPLv2 or later. The icons are HubToolify’s original artwork under the HubToolify Icons licence (free styles) and the Pro licence (Pro styles); the stickers are under the HubToolify Stickers licence. You may use them in your sites and projects, but not redistribute them as an icon or sticker set. See https://hubtoolify.com/licenses.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • New: the HubToolify Sticker block. Browse 1,400+ HubToolify stickers, still and animated, and add one to your Media Library as an image (HubToolify Pro).

2.0.0

  • New: the HubToolify Icon block. Search 3,700+ icons and insert them as inline SVG.
  • New: connect a HubToolify Pro account to insert the 13 Pro styles.
  • Changed: the plugin no longer bundles the icon files or the hti CSS classes; icons are fetched when you insert them and saved in your posts. Replace any <i class="hti …"> markup with the block or the [hti] shortcode.
  • Kept: the [hti] shortcode for the free styles.

1.1.0

  • The self-hosted icon kit with the [hti] shortcode (no longer developed).
